summary: calibre is a self-hosted e-book library manager: a SQLite metadata database (books, authors, series, tags, publishers, ratings, formats, covers, comments, languages, identifiers, annotations, notes, custom columns, preferences, users) with a web content server exposing read/search/OPDS endpoints plus authenticated write endpoints (add/delete books, set fields, set cover, copy-to-library, upload/add formats, set notes, update annotations, full-text indexing, user management) that mutate the library DB and its on-disk book files.
